meta.title: AI Gijinka · Shared World, Individual Personas
meta.description:
Characters follow the selected DSH model, with shared world lore and preferences, individual personalities and memories, and separate optional AI diaries. Create or edit characters and model bindings through conversation; versions in one model family share their character and memories by default. Your customizations take priority during updates.

Optional experimental diaries record each character’s experiences. Idle-time consolidation reviews earlier diary entries and, when AI editing is allowed, the current character’s own dossier. Diaries and consolidation are enabled separately and consume model tokens, including background usage.

The optional cross-platform pet follows the foreground model and task, with character animations, themes, speech bubbles, interaction, work statistics, and balance or plan data where the provider makes it available. Use it inside DSH or on the desktop; personas work without the pet. English and Chinese settings and status messages are available. See installation instructions for desktop platform requirements.

ui.settings.title: Kujira · Personas & Pet
ui.settings.description: Model-linked characters, shared world and separate memories; optional diaries, idle consolidation and a cross-platform task pet with themes and usage statistics. Updates preserve customizations.
ui.pet.display.auto: Automatic (desktop on Windows/Linux/macOS; in-page on other systems)
ui.usage.manual: On model change, task completion, or manual refresh
ui.usage.credentials: Manage account credentials in DSH account settings.
ui.archives.title: World & Character Profiles
ui.archives.description: Open local folders to view character profiles and memories. Sizes reflect files on disk.
ui.archives.help: To change the world, personalities, memories, model bindings, or profile locations, tell the AI in DSH chat. Use this section to view and open folders.
ui.experiments.title: Experimental Features
ui.diary.title: AI Diary
ui.diary.warning: Enabling this uses additional tokens. Usage is uncontrolled and cannot be estimated.
ui.diary.description: Each character has a separate space in the selected folder and decides when, what, and how to write.
ui.diary.openRequested: Requested to open the diary library.
ui.sleep.title: Sleep Consolidation
ui.sleep.description: When all conversation tasks are idle, the currently selected model organizes the current character's diaries from yesterday and earlier. Background consolidation stops when a new task starts.
ui.sleep.warning: Automatically calls AI in the background and uses additional tokens. Usage cannot be estimated.
